title: Columbus Officer Shoots Suspect Armed With a Gun While Fleeing a Traffic Stop
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Columbus, Ohio — On Friday, September 19, 2025, at approximately 5:06 p.m., officers were working uniformed patrol in a marked CPD patrol vehicle and attempted a traffic stop in the area of Fairwood Avenue and Frebis Avenue. The driver, identified as Deontis Williams-Spencer, did not stop for the officers, eventually stopping in the 1400 block of Burstock Road. The driver immediately began running from the vehicle with a firearm in his hand. The driver did not listen to the officer’s commands to stop running and to drop his gun. During the foot pursuit the driver turned toward the officer with the firearm still in his hand. The pursuing officer discharged his firearm, striking the suspect. Williams-Spencer was taken into custody without further incident. Officers rendered medical aid until CFD personnel transported the driver to a local hospital in stable condition. Williams-Spencer faces charges of obstructing official business, a fifth-degree felony, and aggravated menacing, a first-degree misdemeanor. His girlfriend was not charged with a crime. No officers were injured during the incident.
